title: 第7章 八古阵第8章 天选之子
content_zh:
日当清晨，凉风习习，吹得人很是舒服。
陆安早早醒来，因为他必须找到星火学院所在，毕竟偌大的星火城想找到一个地方实在是太难，然而事实并不像他所想的那样，因为几乎所有人都在朝着一个方向赶去。
陆安并不傻，觉得这些人应该也是去星火学院的，便随着人群走去，果然在走过几条街后，一片恢弘的建筑就出现在眼前。
当陆安见到这些建筑的时候有些怔住，他从没见过如此雄伟的房子，而且还这么大一片。足足看了好一会陆安才回过神来，眉头一皱，深吸一口气往前走去。
陆安并没有莽撞去排队，而是先跑到队伍最前面看看到底如何测试的。毕竟他根本不知道所谓的天元之力为何物，更不知道如何才能通过测试。对于这场能改变命运的测试，他是格外小心谨慎的。
然而，当他跑到最前面的时候却有些失望，因为这长长的队伍只是一个报名的窗口，真正测试的地方并不在这里，而是要进入里面一个房子中进行测试。
有些郁闷的陆安只能回到队尾，准备去排漫漫长队。然而当他刚走到队尾站好的时候，肩膀却突然被人拍了一下。
陆安一愣，回头看去，然而看到身后的人后，却又是一愣！
好漂亮！
比村里的小蛮还要漂亮！
女孩的眼睛很亮很亮，仿佛散发着光芒。她的五官只能用精致来形容，完美到无可挑剔。皮肤白璧无瑕、吹弹可破，仿佛碰一下都会污染一样。她的黑发安静散在身后，与这一张白皙精致的脸完美相配。
很难想象，一个看起来不过十来岁的小女孩会美成这个样子，莫说是陆安，就连其他人也忍不住纷纷侧目。而对于陆安来说，这女孩完全重新定义了美丽的意义。
只是，这女孩的眼神有些冰冷，声音也仿佛带着凉气，说道，“你插队了，站在我后面去。”
陆安闻言一愣，回过神来，跟着皱眉说道，“我刚刚来的时候明明没人！”
漂亮归漂亮，但也不能横行霸道吧？
女孩的秀眉一蹙，冷冷说道，“那是你眼睛有问题，你去不去后面？”
“不去！”面对女孩的威胁，陆安直接冷哼一声，说道，“我又没插队！”
言毕，陆安也不再搭理女孩，直接转过头去，只留下女孩阴沉着脸站在后面。
只见女孩沉着脸，粉拳紧握。而就在她的拳头上，一层金色悄悄浮上来！
“孩子，赶紧排队，再晚上午都轮不到你了！”

听到身后传来声音，女孩秀眉一紧，拳头上的金色瞬间消散。只见她深吸一口气，冷冰冰的看着前面这个穿着破破烂烂的男孩。
“你最好祈祷自己无法进入学院。”女孩心里冷漠想道，“否则你一定会后悔！”
站在前面的陆安只觉得一阵阴风刮过，忍不住打了个寒颤，但想想大早上的怎么会有阴风，便又什么事都没发生的站在前面。
只见陆安一会伸个懒腰，一会活动活动身体，在他身后的女孩则是一脸阴沉，在她眼里，这是对方对自己的挑衅。
就这样，两人慢慢排着队伍，只是人实在是太多了。虽然一共有十几支队伍，但依然排了足足两个时辰之久，陆安才来到队伍的前面。
前面只有三个人，陆安一直在伸头看着前面，发现每个人都需要填一个表格才行，顿时皱起眉头犯难起来。
虽然他经常随父母出门做苦工，父母也教他识字过，只不过现在的他只会认字，不会写字。准确来说，从小到大他还从没写过一个字。
趁着前面还有人，陆安想象自己名字的模样，赶紧在手心写着自己的名字，反复练习着。然而填这张表格很简单，只需要写上名字和年龄，马上就到陆安了。
content_en:
That morning, the cool breeze blew, making people very comfortable.
Lu An woke up early because he had to find the location of Spark Academy. After all, it was too difficult to find a place in the huge Spark City. However, the reality was not what he thought, because almost everyone was rushing in the same direction.
Lu An was not stupid. He thought that these people should also go to Spark Academy, so he followed the crowd. Sure enough, after walking a few streets, a magnificent building appeared in front of him.
Lu An was a little stunned when he saw these buildings. He had never seen such a majestic house and it was so large. After looking at Lu An for a long time, he came back to his senses, frowned, took a deep breath and walked forward.
Lu An did not rush into the queue, but ran to the front of the line to see how the test was done. After all, he had no idea what the so-called Tianyuan Power was, let alone how to pass the test. He was extremely cautious about this fate-changing test.
However, when he ran to the front, he was a little disappointed, because this long line was just a registration window, and the real test place was not here, but had to enter a house inside for the test.
Lu An, who was a little depressed, could only go back to the end of the queue and prepare to wait in the long queue. However, when he just reached the end of the line and stood up, someone suddenly tapped him on the shoulder.
Lu An was stunned and looked back, but when he saw the person behind him, he was stunned again!
So beautiful!
Even more beautiful than Xiaoman in the village!
The girl's eyes are very bright, as if they are emitting light. Her facial features can only be described as exquisite, impeccable. The skin is flawless and can be broken by blows, as if it will be polluted if touched. Her black hair was spread quietly behind her, perfectly matching her fair and delicate face.
It was hard to imagine that a little girl who looked no more than ten years old could be so beautiful. Not to mention Lu An, even others couldn't help but look at her with side eyes. For Lu An, this girl completely redefined the meaning of beauty.
However, the girl's eyes were a little cold, and her voice seemed to be cold as she said, "You jumped in line, stand behind me."
Lu An was stunned when he heard this, then came to his senses, then frowned and said, "There was no one when I just came here!"
You're beautiful, but you can't be overbearing, right?
The girl frowned and said coldly, "That's because there's something wrong with your eyes. Can you go to the back?"
"No!" Faced with the girl's threat, Lu An snorted coldly and said, "I didn't jump in line!"
After speaking, Lu An stopped talking to the girl and turned his head directly, leaving the girl standing behind with a gloomy face.
The girl had a sullen face and clenched her pink fists. And just on her fist, a layer of gold quietly emerged!
"Kid, hurry up and get in line. It won't be your turn any later in the morning!"
Hearing the voice coming from behind, the girl frowned, and the golden color on her fists instantly dissipated. She took a deep breath and looked coldly at the boy in ragged clothes in front of her.
"You'd better pray that you can't enter the academy." The girl thought coldly in her heart, "Otherwise you will definitely regret it!"
Lu An, who was standing in front, felt a gust of wind blowing by and couldn't help but shudder. However, thinking about how there was such a cold wind in the morning, he stood in front without anything happening.
Lu An could be seen stretching and moving his body for a while, while the girl behind him had a gloomy look on his face. In her eyes, this was a provocation against her.
In this way, the two of them slowly lined up, but there were too many people. Although there were more than a dozen teams in total, it still took two hours before Lu An came to the front of the team.
There were only three people in front of him. Lu An kept looking ahead and found that everyone needed to fill out a form. He suddenly frowned and became confused.
Although he often goes out with his parents to doAs a hard worker, his parents also taught him how to read, but now he can only read but not write. To be precise, he has never written a word since he was a child.
While there were still people in front of him, Lu An imagined what his name would look like, and quickly wrote his name on the palm of his hand, practicing over and over again. However, filling out this form is very simple. You only need to write your name and age, and you will be in Lu'an immediately.
